title: Time off
subtitle: Plan absences, see availability and keep balances clear.
requestDialogDescription: Choose the person, leave type and dates, then review the charge before submitting.
calendarLegend: Shaded: weekends · Filled purple: unavailable · Purple outline: approved leave · Amber: company holiday · Dashed: unknown schedule.
setupTitle: Set up your team’s time off
setupHint: Start with an editable template: 21 vacation days with unlimited carryover, 10 flexible days that expire at year end, and unpaid leave that pauses accrual. Nothing is applied until you choose to start.
setupWaiting: An owner or administrator can configure the leave policy for this workspace.
includeDefaultHolidays: Include 31 December and 1 January as free company holidays
policyYearHint: Each version applies from its year onward. Copy a version to change future rules; historical corrections require a reason.
name: Name
pausesAccrual: Pause paid leave accrual over the entire calendar interval
capacityUnavailable: Remove these days from available capacity
allowNegative: Allow an explicitly approved negative balance
companyHolidaysHint: No leave balance is charged. To charge a personal holiday allowance instead, assign a leave request to selected people.
correctionReasonHint: A reason is required when changing historical rules, schedules or approved past days. Changes are recorded.
accountingHint: By default, allowance accrues from employment start. For an import, enter balances as of the accounting start; accrual before that date is replaced by these balances.
pausesAccrualHint: This leave pauses paid allowance accrual for every calendar day in the interval, including weekends.
noBalanceCharge: This type does not consume a paid leave balance.
profileRequired: An administrator needs to set this person’s employment dates and schedule first.
assignToPeople: Assign and approve for several people
bulkHint: The entire assignment is validated and saved together. If any person cannot take this leave, nobody is partially assigned.
explicitNegativeApproval: Explicitly approve a negative balance where the policy permits it
requestHint: Only scheduled working days are charged. Future approvals reserve balance immediately; the server checks earned allowance at the requested dates.
pastLocked: Past days are locked. An administrator can record a correction with a reason.
futureTailOnly: The request has started. You can shorten its future portion; started and past days stay unchanged.
noBalances: No paid allowances configured for this person.
balanceHint: Future reservations are separate from earned days. Approval also checks projected accrual at each future leave date.
uncertain: The result is not confirmed. Keep this page open and retry the exact submission.
staleRevisionError: This request was modified elsewhere. Load the latest version to continue editing.
previewStaleError: Server data changed since your last review. Refresh the preview to continue.
availabilityFailed: Availability could not be loaded. This does not mean everyone is available.
availabilityNotConfigured: Availability is not configured. Set up time off and schedules to see absence bands.
availabilityUnknownPerson: This assignee’s schedule is not configured.
availabilityOverlap: Unavailable on {{count}} task dates in this view.
ganttLegend: Weekend columns are shaded. Availability bands mark scheduled hours removed by approved time off or a company holiday.
capacityHint: Choose a separate interval and people. Capacity includes people with no tasks and is counted once per person, regardless of task tags or projects.
capacityIntervalRequired: Choose both dates to enable capacity. The inclusive range may be at most 366 days.
capacityUnknown: {{count}} people have no configured schedule; their capacity is unknown.
capacityUnconfigured: Time off is not configured. Capacity is unknown.
capacityAttribution: Capacity follows the selected dates and people.
capacityNoPeople: No selected people. Choose at least one person.
saveBeforePersonSwitch: Save this person’s changes before switching to another person.
noBalanceChanges: No balance changes at the current calculation date.
projectionDeficits: {{count}} projected balance deficits require attention. Approval cannot bypass a policy that prohibits a negative balance.
reviewSourceHint: This preview uses current server data. Saving checks the same source version again.
overlappingRequests: This interval overlaps an existing request. Resolve the overlap before submitting.
capacityPairedHint: Plan and Fact follow task filters; — means no recorded pair.
saveRequestBeforeApproval: Save or undo your request changes before reviewing its approval.
changedElsewhere: This item changed elsewhere. Your unsaved edits are kept; load the latest version before trying again.
loadLatest: Load latest and discard local edits
typeUnavailableForYear: Choose a leave type available in this policy year.
capacityAttributionDetails: Plan and Fact use the report’s task and field filters. They are recorded task values, not dated work logs; this view does not invent daily actual hours. Capacity uses its own interval and people.
capacityPairedDetails: Plan and Fact columns use the same eligible paired tasks as the configured comparison. A dash means no known paired value; it does not mean zero hours worked.
useOpeningBalance: Use a custom accounting start and opening balances
profileReasonHint: Past or current corrections and timezone changes require a reason. Future-only changes do not.
profileReasonRequired: Add a reason before saving this correction.
scheduleHint: Daily working hours define scheduled capacity before holidays and time off. For a temporary change, add a period on its start date and another to restore the usual hours.
historyHint: All dates, leave types and recorded charges for this person. Open an entry to review or correct it.
noPersonHistory: No time off recorded for this person.
saveRequestBeforeSwitch: Save or discard your request changes below before switching person or view.
employmentCorrectionHint: You can save the correct employment start with your reason. These balances are recalculated from recorded absences; this does not approve additional leave or change the rules for new requests.
previewBalanceWarningHint: These are conflicts found in this preview. Review the dates and working-day charge; a rejected save may have another cause.
historicalCorrectionHint: You can save this fully elapsed date correction with your reason. These balances are recalculated from the changed dates; this does not approve additional leave or change the rules for new requests.
historicalRecordingHint: You can review without a reason. Enter a reason to save dates that have started or are in the past. A fully elapsed absence will be recorded as approved history.
historicalRecordingReasonRequired: Enter a reason before saving dates that have started or are in the past.
historicalRecordingAdvisory: Recording historical absence ending {{date}} ({{hours}} working hours unavailable). This will be saved as approved history.
historicalRecordingDeficits: This historical recording will reduce balances on the following dates:
administrationWarningHint: These conflicts are advisory for administrators. You can save the correction; history and its audit trail remain intact.
scopedWarningsTruncated: Only available warnings for this person are shown. Some workspace warnings were omitted; review this person’s changes for their full calculation.
warningACCOUNTING_BEFORE_EMPLOYMENT: Accounting starts before employment; accrual starts when employment begins.
warningOUTSIDE_EMPLOYMENT: An absence is outside the employment dates.
warningBEFORE_ACCOUNTING: History before the accounting start is retained and excluded from this balance.
warningMISSING_POLICY: No policy covers part of this period; no leave accrues there.
warningMISSING_TYPE: This leave type is missing from part of the policy history.
warningTYPE_BEHAVIOR_CHANGED: The policy behavior differs from the saved absence snapshot.
warningOVERLAP: Absences overlap; availability counts unavailable time once.
warningNEGATIVE_BALANCE: The calculated leave balance is negative.
warningPAID_POOL_DEBT: An accrual pause coexists with a negative paid-leave balance.
warningADJUSTMENT_BEFORE_ACCOUNTING: This adjustment precedes accounting and is retained outside the current balance.
accountingFollowsHire: Custom accounting is off: the accounting start follows the employment start.
administrationReasonHint: A reason is required for historical changes. Routine future edits do not need one.
invalidDateOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.
invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, for example Europe/Nicosia.
administrationNoConflicts: No business conflicts found in this preview.
